_comment: Péter's press, appearances and working relationships — the single source of truth.
Add or remove an entry here, run tools/prepare-for-upload.py, and every page on
the site updates. Nothing else to edit.
'performerIn'  = events he appeared or spoke at.
'subjectOf'    = articles and interviews about him or featuring him.
'affiliation'  = organisations he works with. These come and go — when one ends,
delete it here and rerun. Do NOT use this for one-off jobs.
'hasCredential' = diplomas, certificates and memberships. Full list;
